name: checkbox-group
purpose: Several related, independent choices in a <fieldset> + <legend>, built on native checkboxes that share one field name, with group help text, required and min/max selection validation, and one localized validation message.
whenToUse: Choosing any number of options from a short, visible list (roughly 2 to 10).
Selections with a minimum or maximum count, such as "pick up to three topics".
whenNotToUse: Exactly one choice: use Radio Group.
Long or searchable lists: use a multi-select Combobox or Listbox.
A single yes/no choice: use Checkbox.
responsive: Vertical by default. `orientation: 'horizontal'` lays options out in a wrapping row. Labels and option help text wrap; each row is at least touch-target-min tall.
rtl: Logical properties and flex layout: boxes sit at the inline start and horizontal options flow from the inline start in both directions.
theme: Same box visuals as Checkbox: color-surface box with a color-border-strong boundary; checked uses a color-primary fill with a color-on-primary check mark. Invalid: color-error-fg boundaries. Forced-colors mode uses Canvas, CanvasText, Highlight, HighlightText, and GrayText with forced-color-adjust: none.
security: Legend, option labels, help text, and messages are rendered with textContent. Validation messages never include selected values. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. With `name`, every checked native checkbox submits `name=value`, matching native form serialization.

budgets.budget: < 2 ms average in headless Chromium (target; not yet covered by the performance test)

performance.testedScale: Unit-tested with up to 4 options per group; intended for short lists (up to about 20 options).

limitations: minSelected and maxSelected apply once anything is selected; an empty optional group is valid (HTML constraint semantics). Use `required` to demand a selection.
Selection-count messages have singular and plural forms only; languages with more plural categories need a custom validate message.
Group-level help text and errors are referenced from the fieldset; some screen readers announce fieldset descriptions only when entering the group.
unsupported: HTML inside option labels or the legend.
A mixed "select all" row inside the group (compose a Checkbox with the group instead).
antiPatterns: Using a checkbox group for mutually exclusive options.
Hiding the legend when the options do not make sense on their own.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/checkbox-group: AuiCheckboxGroup directive ([auiCheckboxGroup]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/checkbox-group: AuiCheckboxGroup component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
